name: Fleet Factory
tagline: A weekday close-out over inbox, calendar and whatever is in flight
description: Written as the closing routine for a desk operated by several bots. Late in the day it sweeps the calendar, the inbox and whatever is mid-flight, then reports only what shifted rather than dumping a full status. Outbound items wait for your sign-off, and credentials stay off the shared board.
author: SacredFolio
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
